transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, this is Aisha speaking. How can I help?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello. I've just opened my bill and it's ninety-four pounds when it's normally forty-two, and I'm on a pension so this is really worrying me.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can hear how worrying that is, a jump like that would worry anyone. Let's go through it together and find out what's happened. Could you tell me the first line of your address and your postcode so I can find your account?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it's 12 Cedar Lane, LS8 4PD.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Desmond. So your latest bill is ninety-four pounds instead of the usual forty-two, and you'd like to know why. Have I got that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Did you make any calls abroad, or to any premium or 09 numbers, in the last month?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, I don't think so. I only ring my daughter and she's in Leeds.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. Have you ordered any films or sports from the TV box recently?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, I don't even know how to do that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's fine. Let me place you on a brief hold while I go through the charges line by line.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Desmond. I've found it. There's a charge of fifty-two pounds for a film package that was added on the eighth, through the TV box remote.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: A film package? I never did that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I believe you. It was added from the box itself, and with no PIN set on purchases, it only takes a couple of button presses. Do you have grandchildren or anyone else who uses the TV?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh. My grandson stayed over that weekend. He was playing with the remote.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That would explain it. I'm going to cancel the package straight away and refund the fifty-two pounds to your account, and I'll set a purchase PIN on the box so it can't happen again. Is that okay with you?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes please, that would be wonderful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: All done. The refund will show on your next bill, which brings it back to forty-two pounds. The purchase PIN is 1 2 0 8, and I'll send it to you by post as well.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you so much.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can I just check: does that fully answer the problem with your bill today, or is there anything about the charges that still doesn't look right to you?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that's sorted it. Thank you, dear.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome, Desmond. So the package is cancelled, the refund is on its way, and the box is protected. Is there anything else I can do for you?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, that's all.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Take care and have a good afternoon.
